alt: A newly built smooth limestone pyramid with a gleaming gold cap and a long construction ramp where tiny workers haul stone blocks on sledges, with two smaller pyramids and a river valley at golden sunset

provenance.prompt: Painterly digital illustration for a strategy-game encyclopedia, wide 16:9 landscape, warm golden-hour light with deep teal shadows, rich earthy palette, soft visible brushwork, clean readable silhouette. The main subject is centred and fully inside the middle 60% of the frame, with generous calm empty sky above and open desert sand below it (nothing important in the top or bottom 15%, and the subject must not touch any edge). No people in the foreground (tiny distant figures are fine). No text, no letters, no hieroglyphs, no numbers, no logos, no flags, no signs, no inscriptions, no watermark, no frame or border. Subject: An invented great stone pyramid, as it might have looked when newly built, rising from a flat desert plateau at golden hour, seen from a low sand rise. Its four smooth sides are clad in pale polished limestone that glows gold on the sunlit face and deep teal in shadow, with a gleaming pointed cap at the very top. Beside it, a long sloping construction ramp of stacked mud-brick and rubble climbs one corner, with tiny distant workers hauling stone blocks on wooden sledges and wet-sand tracks, rows of workers' huts and a small harbour canal far behind, and two smaller satellite pyramids at its side. A single plain obelisk-free causeway of pale stone leads away across the sand, and a few date palms mark a distant river valley under a clear apricot-and-teal sky. The stone is plain and smooth, with no carvings, hieroglyphs or lettering anywhere. The great pyramid is the clear focal point, with calm sky above and open sand below.
